opt.texthooker.launchAtStartup: Launch texthooker server automatically when SubMiner starts.
opt.texthooker.openBrowser: Open the texthooker page in the default browser when the server starts.
opt.subtitlePosition.yPercent: Vertical position of the subtitle overlay expressed as a percentage from the bottom of the screen.
opt.auto_start_overlay: Show the visible subtitle overlay automatically when the bundled mpv plugin starts SubMiner.
opt.uiLanguage: User interface language. system uses the operating system language, en uses English, zh-CN uses Simplified Chinese.
opt.secondarySub.secondarySubLanguages: Language code priority list used to auto-select a secondary subtitle track when available.
opt.secondarySub.autoLoadSecondarySub: Automatically load a matching secondary subtitle when the primary subtitle loads.
opt.secondarySub.defaultMode: Default visibility mode for the secondary subtitle bar.
opt.annotationWebsocket.enabled: Annotated subtitle websocket server enabled state.
opt.subsync.replace: Replace the active subtitle file when sync completes.
opt.subsync.alass_path: Optional absolute path to the alass binary used by subsync. Leave empty to auto-discover from PATH.
opt.subsync.ffsubsync_path: Optional absolute path to the ffsubsync binary used by subsync. Leave empty to auto-discover from PATH.
opt.subsync.ffmpeg_path: Optional absolute path to the ffmpeg binary used by subsync. Leave empty to auto-discover from PATH.
opt.startupWarmups.lowPowerMode: Defer startup warmups except Yomitan extension.
opt.startupWarmups.mecab: Warm up MeCab tokenizer at startup.
opt.startupWarmups.yomitanExtension: Warm up Yomitan extension at startup.
opt.startupWarmups.subtitleDictionaries: Warm up subtitle dictionaries at startup.
opt.startupWarmups.jellyfinRemoteSession: Warm up Jellyfin remote session at startup.
opt.updates.enabled: Run automatic update checks in the background.
opt.updates.checkIntervalHours: Minimum hours between automatic update checks.
opt.updates.notificationType: How SubMiner announces available updates. overlay shows notifications on the overlay, system uses OS notifications, both uses overlay and system. osd and osd-system are legacy config-file-only values.
opt.updates.channel: Release channel used for update checks.
opt.shortcuts.toggleVisibleOverlayGlobal: Global accelerator that toggles overlay visibility from anywhere on the system. Use null to disable.
opt.shortcuts.copySubtitle: Accelerator that copies the current subtitle line to the clipboard.
opt.shortcuts.copySubtitleMultiple: Accelerator that copies consecutive subtitle lines while the multi-copy window stays open.
opt.shortcuts.updateLastCardFromClipboar: Accelerator that updates the last mined Anki card using the current clipboard contents.
opt.shortcuts.triggerFieldGrouping: Accelerator that triggers Kiku field grouping on duplicate cards.
opt.shortcuts.triggerSubsync: Accelerator that triggers subsync against the active subtitle file.
opt.shortcuts.mineSentence: Accelerator that mines the current sentence as a new Anki card.
opt.shortcuts.mineSentenceMultiple: Accelerator that mines consecutive sentences while the multi-mine window stays open.
opt.shortcuts.toggleSecondarySub: Accelerator that toggles the secondary subtitle bar visibility.
opt.shortcuts.markAudioCard: Accelerator that marks the last mined card as an audio card.
opt.shortcuts.openCharacterDictionaryMan: Accelerator that opens the character dictionary manager modal.
opt.shortcuts.openRuntimeOptions: Accelerator that opens the runtime options modal.
opt.shortcuts.openJimaku: Accelerator that opens the Jimaku subtitle search modal.
opt.shortcuts.openSessionHelp: Accelerator that opens the session help / keybinding cheatsheet.
opt.shortcuts.openControllerSelect: Accelerator that opens the controller selection and learn-mode modal.
opt.shortcuts.openControllerDebug: Accelerator that opens the controller debug modal with live axis/button readouts.
opt.shortcuts.toggleSubtitleSidebar: Accelerator that toggles the subtitle sidebar visibility.
opt.shortcuts.toggleNotificationHistory: Accelerator that toggles the overlay notification history panel.
opt.subtitleStyle.primaryDefaultMode: Default primary subtitle bar visibility mode. hidden hides it, visible shows it, hover reveals it on hover.
opt.subtitleStyle.css: CSS declaration object applied to primary subtitles after normal subtitle style defaults.
opt.subtitleStyle.secondary.css: CSS declaration object applied to secondary subtitles after normal subtitle style defaults.
opt.subtitleStyle.enableJlpt: Enable JLPT vocabulary level underlines. When disabled, JLPT tagging lookup and underlines are skipped.
opt.subtitleStyle.preserveLineBreaks: Preserve line breaks in visible overlay subtitle rendering. When false, line breaks are flattened to spaces for a single-line flow.
opt.subtitleStyle.autoPauseVideoOnHover: Automatically pause mpv playback while hovering subtitle text, then resume on leave.
opt.subtitleStyle.autoPauseVideoOnYomita: Automatically pause mpv playback while Yomitan popup is open, then resume when popup closes.
opt.subtitleStyle.primaryVisibleOnYomita: Keep the primary subtitle bar visible while a Yomitan popup is open when primary subtitles are in hover mode.
opt.subtitleStyle.hoverTokenColor: Hex color used for hovered subtitle token highlight in mpv.
opt.subtitleStyle.hoverTokenBackgroundCo: CSS color used for hovered subtitle token background highlight in mpv.
opt.subtitleStyle.nameMatchEnabled: Enable character dictionary sync and subtitle token coloring for character-name matches.
opt.subtitleStyle.nameMatchImagesEnabled: Show small character portraits beside subtitle tokens matched from the SubMiner character dictionary.
opt.subtitleStyle.nameMatchColor: Hex color used when a subtitle token matches an entry from the SubMiner character dictionary.
opt.subtitleStyle.knownWordColor: Color used for known-word subtitle highlights.
opt.subtitleStyle.nPlusOneColor: Color used for the single N+1 target token subtitle highlight.
opt.subtitleStyle.frequencyDictionary.en: Enable frequency-dictionary-based highlighting based on token rank.
opt.subtitleStyle.frequencyDictionary.so: Optional absolute path to a frequency dictionary directory. If empty, built-in discovery search paths are used.
opt.subtitleStyle.frequencyDictionary.to: Only color tokens with frequency rank <= topX (default: 10000).
opt.subtitleStyle.frequencyDictionary.mo: single: use one color for all matching tokens. banded: use color ramp by frequency band.
opt.subtitleStyle.frequencyDictionary.ma: headword: frequency lookup uses dictionary form. surface: lookup uses subtitle-visible token text.
opt.subtitleStyle.frequencyDictionary.ba: Five colors used for rank bands when mode is `banded` (from most common to least within topX).
opt.subtitleSidebar.enabled: Enable the subtitle sidebar feature for parsed subtitle sources.
opt.subtitleSidebar.autoOpen: Automatically open the subtitle sidebar once during overlay startup.
opt.subtitleSidebar.layout: Render the subtitle sidebar as a floating overlay or reserve space inside mpv.
opt.subtitleSidebar.toggleKey: KeyboardEvent.code used to toggle the subtitle sidebar open and closed.
opt.subtitleSidebar.pauseVideoOnHover: Pause mpv while hovering the subtitle sidebar, then resume on leave.
opt.subtitleSidebar.autoScroll: Auto-scroll the active subtitle cue into view while playback advances.
opt.subtitleSidebar.css: CSS declaration object applied to the subtitle sidebar. Includes color, background-color, and all font properties.
opt.subtitleSidebar.maxWidth: Maximum sidebar width in CSS pixels.
opt.subtitleSidebar.opacity: Base opacity applied to the sidebar shell.
opt.subtitleSidebar.backgroundColor: Background color for the subtitle sidebar shell.
opt.subtitleSidebar.textColor: Default cue text color in the subtitle sidebar.
opt.subtitleSidebar.fontFamily: Font family used for subtitle sidebar cue text.
opt.subtitleSidebar.fontSize: Base font size for subtitle sidebar cue text in CSS pixels.
opt.subtitleSidebar.timestampColor: Timestamp color in the subtitle sidebar.
opt.subtitleSidebar.activeLineColor: Text color for the active subtitle cue.
opt.subtitleSidebar.activeLineBackground: Background color for the active subtitle cue.
opt.subtitleSidebar.hoverLineBackgroundC: Background color for hovered subtitle cues.
opt.ankiConnect.url: Base URL of the AnkiConnect HTTP server.
opt.ankiConnect.proxy.enabled: Enable local AnkiConnect-compatible proxy for push-based auto-enrichment.
opt.ankiConnect.proxy.host: Bind host for local AnkiConnect proxy.
opt.ankiConnect.proxy.port: Bind port for local AnkiConnect proxy.
opt.ankiConnect.proxy.upstreamUrl: Upstream AnkiConnect URL proxied by local AnkiConnect proxy.
opt.ankiConnect.tags: Tags to add to cards mined or updated by SubMiner. Provide an empty array to disable automatic tagging.
opt.ankiConnect.deck: Restrict duplicate detection and card enrichment to this Anki deck. Leave empty to use the Yomitan mining deck when available.
opt.ankiConnect.fields.word: Card field for the mined word or expression text.
opt.ankiConnect.fields.audio: Card field that receives generated sentence audio.
opt.ankiConnect.fields.image: Card field that receives the captured screenshot or animated image.
opt.ankiConnect.fields.sentence: Card field that receives the source sentence text.
opt.ankiConnect.fields.miscInfo: Card field that receives the miscellaneous info pattern (see ankiConnect.metadata.pattern).
opt.ankiConnect.fields.translation: Card field that receives the current selection or translated text.
opt.ankiConnect.ai.enabled: Enable AI provider usage for Anki translation/enrichment flows.
opt.ankiConnect.ai.model: Optional model override for Anki AI translation/enrichment flows.
opt.ankiConnect.ai.systemPrompt: Optional system prompt override for Anki AI translation/enrichment flows.
opt.ankiConnect.behavior.overwriteAudio: When updating an existing card, overwrite the audio field instead of skipping it.
opt.ankiConnect.behavior.overwriteImage: When updating an existing card, overwrite the image field instead of skipping it.
opt.ankiConnect.behavior.mediaInsertMode: Whether new media is appended after or prepended before existing field contents on update.
opt.ankiConnect.behavior.highlightWord: Bold the mined word inside the sentence field on the saved Anki card.
opt.ankiConnect.behavior.notificationTyp: Notification surface used to announce mining and update outcomes. overlay shows notifications on the overlay, system uses OS notifications, both uses overlay and system. osd and osd-system are legacy config-file-only values.
opt.ankiConnect.media.syncAnimatedImageT: For animated AVIF images, prepend a frozen first frame matching the existing word-audio duration so motion starts with sentence audio.
opt.ankiConnect.media.generateAudio: Generate sentence audio for mined cards.
opt.ankiConnect.media.generateImage: Generate screenshot or animated image for mined cards.
opt.ankiConnect.media.imageType: Image capture type: "static" for a single still frame, "avif" for an animated AVIF.
opt.ankiConnect.media.imageFormat: Encoding format used when imageType is "static".
opt.ankiConnect.media.imageQuality: Quality (0-100) used for lossy static image encoders.
opt.ankiConnect.media.imageMaxWidth: Maximum width for static images, in pixels. Set to 0 to preserve the source resolution.
opt.ankiConnect.media.imageMaxHeight: Maximum height for static images, in pixels. Set to 0 to preserve the source resolution.
opt.ankiConnect.media.animatedFps: Target frame rate for animated AVIF captures.
opt.ankiConnect.media.animatedMaxWidth: Maximum width applied to animated AVIF captures.
opt.ankiConnect.media.animatedMaxHeight: Maximum height for animated AVIF captures, in pixels. Set to 0 to preserve aspect ratio.
opt.ankiConnect.media.animatedCrf: Animated AVIF CRF quality target. Lower values produce larger, higher-quality files.
opt.ankiConnect.media.audioPadding: Seconds of padding appended to both ends of generated sentence audio and animated AVIF clips.
opt.ankiConnect.media.fallbackDuration: Fallback clip duration in seconds when subtitle timing data is unavailable.
opt.ankiConnect.media.maxMediaDuration: Maximum allowed media clip duration in seconds.
opt.ankiConnect.knownWords.matchMode: Known-word matching strategy for subtitle annotations. Cache matches always receive known-word highlighting even when POS filters suppress other annotation types.
opt.ankiConnect.knownWords.highlightEnab: Enable fast local highlighting for words already known in Anki.
opt.ankiConnect.knownWords.addMinedWords: Immediately append newly mined card words into the known-word cache.
opt.ankiConnect.nPlusOne.enabled: Enable N+1 subtitle highlighting (highlights the one unknown word in a sentence). Requires known-word cache data.
opt.ankiConnect.nPlusOne.minSentenceWord: Minimum sentence word count required for N+1 targeting (default: 3).
opt.ankiConnect.knownWords.decks: Decks and expression/word fields for known-word cache. Object mapping deck names to arrays of field names to extract, e.g. { "Kaishi 1.5k": ["Word"] }.
opt.ankiConnect.isKiku.enabled: Enable Kiku-specific mining behaviors (duplicate handling, field grouping).
opt.ankiConnect.isKiku.deleteDuplicateIn: When Kiku field grouping is "auto", delete the duplicate source card after grouping completes.
opt.ankiConnect.isLapis.enabled: Enable Lapis-specific mining behaviors and sentence card model targeting.
opt.ankiConnect.isLapis.sentenceCardMode: Note type name used by Lapis sentence cards.
opt.ankiConnect.metadata.pattern: Template used to render the miscInfo field. Placeholders include %f (filename) and %t (timestamp).
opt.jimaku.apiBaseUrl: Base URL of the Jimaku subtitle search API.
opt.jimaku.apiKey: Jimaku API key. Optional but recommended for higher rate limits. Get one for free at https://jimaku.cc.
opt.jimaku.apiKeyCommand: Shell command that prints the Jimaku API key to stdout. Used instead of apiKey to avoid storing the key in plain text.
opt.jimaku.languagePreference: Preferred language used in Jimaku search.
opt.anilist.accessToken: Optional explicit AniList access token override; leave empty to use locally stored token from setup.
opt.anilist.characterDictionary.maxLoade: Maximum number of most-recently-used anime snapshots included in the merged Yomitan character dictionary.
opt.anilist.characterDictionary.profileS: Yomitan profile scope for character dictionary settings updates.
opt.anilist.characterDictionary.collapsi: Open the Description section by default in character dictionary glossary entries.
Open the Character Information section by default in character dictionary glossary entries.
Open the Voiced by section by default in character dictionary glossary entries.
opt.yomitan.externalProfilePath: Optional external Yomitan Electron profile path to use in read-only mode for shared dictionaries/settings. Example: ~/.config/gsm_overlay
opt.mpv.executablePath: Optional absolute path to mpv.exe for Windows launch flows. Leave empty to auto-discover from SUBMINER_MPV_PATH or PATH.
opt.mpv.launchMode: Default window state for SubMiner-managed mpv launches.
opt.mpv.profile: Optional mpv profile name passed to SubMiner-managed mpv launches. Leave empty to pass no profile.
opt.mpv.socketPath: mpv IPC socket path used by SubMiner-managed playback and the bundled mpv plugin.
opt.mpv.backend: Window tracking backend passed to the bundled mpv plugin. Auto detects the current platform.
opt.mpv.autoStartSubMiner: Start SubMiner in the background when SubMiner-managed mpv loads a file.
opt.mpv.pauseUntilOverlayReady: Pause mpv on visible-overlay auto-start until SubMiner signals subtitle tokenization readiness.
opt.mpv.subminerBinaryPath: Optional SubMiner app binary path passed to the bundled mpv plugin. Leave empty to use the launcher-detected app path.
opt.mpv.aniskipEnabled: Enable AniSkip intro detection, chapter markers, and the skip-intro key.
opt.mpv.aniskipButtonKey: mpv key used to skip the detected intro while the skip prompt is visible.
opt.jellyfin.enabled: Enable optional Jellyfin integration and CLI control commands.
opt.jellyfin.serverUrl: Base Jellyfin server URL (for example: http://localhost:8096).
opt.jellyfin.recentServers: Recently authenticated Jellyfin server URLs shown in setup.
opt.jellyfin.username: Default Jellyfin username used during CLI login.
opt.jellyfin.defaultLibraryId: Optional default Jellyfin library ID for item listing.
opt.jellyfin.remoteControlEnabled: Enable Jellyfin remote cast control mode.
opt.jellyfin.remoteControlAutoConnect: Auto-connect to the configured remote control target.
opt.jellyfin.autoAnnounce: When enabled, automatically trigger remote announce/visibility check on websocket connect.
opt.jellyfin.pullPictures: Enable Jellyfin poster/icon fetching for launcher menus.
opt.jellyfin.iconCacheDir: Directory used by launcher for cached Jellyfin poster icons.
opt.jellyfin.directPlayPreferred: Try direct play before server-managed transcoding when possible.
opt.jellyfin.directPlayContainers: Container allowlist for direct play decisions.
opt.jellyfin.transcodeVideoCodec: Preferred transcode video codec when direct play is unavailable.
opt.discordPresence.enabled: Enable optional Discord Rich Presence updates.
opt.discordPresence.presenceStyle: Presence card text preset: "default" (clean bilingual), "meme" (Mining and crafting), "japanese" (fully JP), or "minimal".
opt.discordPresence.updateIntervalMs: Minimum interval between presence payload updates.
opt.discordPresence.debounceMs: Debounce delay used to collapse bursty presence updates.
opt.ai.enabled: Enable shared OpenAI-compatible AI provider features.
opt.ai.apiKey: Static API key for the shared OpenAI-compatible AI provider.
opt.ai.apiKeyCommand: Shell command used to resolve the shared AI provider API key.
opt.ai.baseUrl: Base URL for the shared OpenAI-compatible AI provider.
opt.ai.model: Default model identifier requested from the shared AI provider.
opt.ai.systemPrompt: Default system prompt sent with shared AI provider requests.
opt.ai.requestTimeoutMs: Timeout in milliseconds for shared AI provider requests.
opt.immersionTracking.enabled: Enable immersion tracking for mined subtitle metadata.
opt.immersionTracking.dbPath: Optional SQLite database path for immersion tracking. Empty value uses the default app data path.
opt.immersionTracking.batchSize: Buffered telemetry/event writes per SQLite transaction.
opt.immersionTracking.flushIntervalMs: Max delay before queue flush in milliseconds.
opt.immersionTracking.queueCap: In-memory write queue cap before overflow policy applies.
opt.immersionTracking.payloadCapBytes: Max JSON payload size per event before truncation.
opt.immersionTracking.retentionMode: Retention mode (`preset` uses preset values, `advanced` uses explicit values).
opt.immersionTracking.retention.eventsDa: Raw event retention window in days. Use 0 to keep all.
opt.immersionTracking.retention.telemetr: Telemetry retention window in days. Use 0 to keep all.
opt.immersionTracking.retention.sessions: Session retention window in days. Use 0 to keep all.
opt.immersionTracking.retention.dailyRol: Daily rollup retention window in days. Use 0 to keep all.
opt.immersionTracking.retention.monthlyR: Monthly rollup retention window in days. Use 0 to keep all.
opt.immersionTracking.retention.vacuumIn: Minimum days between VACUUM runs. Use 0 to disable.
opt.stats.toggleKey: Key code to toggle the stats overlay.
opt.stats.markWatchedKey: Key code to mark the current video as watched and advance to the next playlist entry.
opt.stats.serverPort: Port for the stats HTTP server.
opt.stats.autoStartServer: Automatically start the stats server on launch.
opt.stats.autoOpenBrowser: Automatically open the stats dashboard in a browser when the server starts.
optLabel.subtitleStyle.primaryVisibleOnY: Keep Primary Visible On Yomitan Popup
optLabel.ankiConnect.media.syncAnimatedI: Sync Animated Image To Word Audio
